propositions: Sonnet 4.6 and Opus 4.8 share identical 1,000,000 token context windows, so escalation from sonnet to opus gains zero additional capacity and is guaranteed to fail at higher cost.

Context-limit retry escalation silently proposes rungs with equal or smaller windows than the current rung, masking the true defect (no escalation occurred) behind a misleading diagnosis (even the largest model failed).

New function escalation_rungs() filters models_at_or_above() to exclude any rung whose declared window is not strictly greater than the last kept rung's, removing no-op escalations from both retry loops.
Both retry loops (pass1_with_ladder and run_focused_finder) must consume escalation_rungs() instead of models_at_or_above() to avoid proposing equal-window rungs as escalations.
